I've written round 479 and the decision is **CONTINUE**. Round 478 passed C with browser checks and is published as `75a6028`, which is the baseline for the next round. Regression is due tomorrow, not today: the date is 2026-11-12 and it is due on or after 2026-11-13.

**Round 478 result (from C's evidence only)**
- The design-docs update is checked by C. That completes the DPG P0 stage, but it is not marked done until root re-runs the two-reviewer design gate and both score 10/10.
- C found one Low (two lightness descriptions in the design doc), and it is deferred.
- A's open code-review items are ruled in D-29z1696: one is accepted, two become deferred Lows, and the rest are recorded as signals for later colour and glow work.

**Round 479: internal Store links stop reloading the page (DPG-FOOTER-LINKS)**
- **What changes:** the 9 Footer links, the cookie banner's Privacy link, the home page "View all" link and one link each in privacy, terms and faq become client-side `<Link>`s.
- **Left as they are, with reasons:** the error page's home link (a full reload is the recovery), the sign-up modal links (the modal would stay open), an unused dropdown, the account pages, and all external and email links.
- **Problem found while testing the change:** with plain `<Link>`s, the first Tab after following a link landed in the middle of the new page instead of on the header logo. Root cause: without a reload, Chrome keeps its Tab starting point where the old link was.
- **Fix:** a small shared helper, `releaseLinkFocus`, moves focus to the top of the page on a normal click or Enter. It does nothing on Ctrl, middle or other modifier clicks, so those open a new tab and focus stays on the link, as today.
- **Checked in a real browser:** I ran the change on a test copy at 1440×900 and 1280×720. The page no longer reloads, it lands at the top, and the first Tab goes to the header logo. Ctrl, middle and Ctrl+Enter clicks behave as they do today.
- **Tests:** the covering set is 10 files and 162 tests, all passing on the test copy. Each of the 6 deliberately broken versions makes them fail. A copies my ready-made version of the 11 files, adds implementation doc 311, and touches 12 files in total.
- **Behaviour differences from today, written into the task:**
  - Screen readers no longer hear the new page title announced. Fixing that needs a change to `root.tsx`, which only root can edit, so it is recorded as a signal and not scheduled.
  - Clicking the link of the page you are already on now scrolls to the top instead of reloading in place.

**Two new Medium bugs**
- **Footer "License" goes to a 404 page.** Both the Footer and the Terms page link to `/license`, which has no page; the 404 page also returns HTTP 200. The licence text is legal content, so it is a question for Saba in `user-review/questions-round-478.md` (Q1). I recommend a real licence page.
- **"Browse Music" on the empty orders page goes to a 404 page.** It links to `/music`, which doesn't exist. The fix is to point it to `/store`, scheduled no later than the first planning after RETRO 480. The same link in the protected downloads page is left to root or Saba.

**Advisor:** available and consulted twice. The second pass caught the Ctrl/middle-click focus problem, which is now fixed, tested and re-measured in the browser.

**Next order:**
1. REGRESSION-2026-11-13
2. RETRO 480
3. DPG-BUTTON-CLEANUP
4. The rest of P1

**For root:**
- Land ROOT-REQ-DPG-PRIMITIVES-PATCH before re-running the design gate; otherwise the stale design-tokens primitive fails the docs item again.
- Re-run the design gate now that P0 is complete.
